Krusader 2.3.0 keeps pasted uppercase text intact in the web desktop, adds a keyboard-layout setting, and folds in the 2.2.1 window-handling changes.

## ✨ Added

- **`KEYBOARD_LAYOUT` setting.** A new template dropdown (default `us`) picks the X keyboard layout loaded at session start, so non-US users get the right symbols and dead keys.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Window switching now uses native openbox gestures.** The v2.2.0 bottom taskbar (tint2) was reverted because it did not fit the KDE/Breeze look. Switch windows with Alt+Tab (Alt+Shift+Tab backwards) or a middle-click on the empty desktop for the full window list, minimised windows included. Krusader stays maximised so the main window does not slip behind.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Pasted UPPERCASE text no longer arrives lowercase.** Copying text like "Big Chicken A Fast Food Conspiracy" in the browser and pasting it into a Krusader dialog produced "big chicken a fast food conspiracy" (issue #27). The web desktop starts its X server without a keyboard map, so Firefox's paste, re-typed as key events over a plain HTTP origin, lost the Shift on every capital. The session now loads a full keyboard map at start so Shift binds and pasted text keeps its case, and the image was rebuilt on the current web desktop base that also restores Firefox's byte-exact paste.
- **A minimised window could disappear with no way back (issue #26).** Krusader's "minimize to tray" is now forced off on every start. The minimal openbox desktop has no system tray, so a tray-hidden window could never be recovered; with the option off, minimising always keeps the window reachable via Alt+Tab or the desktop menu.
- **The image license label now matches the license.** It reported MIT while the LICENSE file is AGPL-3.0.
